scope: Proposition 6.12 (Uniform finite-place upper speed) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After the inner limit of a translated panel link, let t ≥ 0 be the total missing-root coordinate of the source translation, including all slower offsets in that coordinate. The translation is taken on the permissible cocharacter mesh of Section 3. If g is the target residual projectivity, then (6.21) dT ℓT (g) ≤ dSt + Otight(1). Here tightness is on each fixed ordinary input vector, uniformly in the slower translations with this total coordinate as center. The assertion holds coordinatewise, and simultaneously as an upper-tail estimate, on many-panel links.
